_about: Aussie Bush pack: prompts for its new animal calls (GC.Band.CALLS added in js/packs/aussie.js), generated with tools/gen-sounds.js --manifest tools/packs/aussie.sounds.json and written by tools/pick-sounds.js --manifest (which only adds to sounds/index.json). The joey, echidna and bilby reuse the Classic boing, sniff and squeak. Every call has a synthesised stand-in.
common: close-up, isolated, no music, no speech, no background noise

sounds.prompt: A galah cockatoo giving two soft friendly chirpy screeches, chet chet, cute, not harsh
A sulphur-crested cockatoo giving one short cheeky squawk, playful and not too harsh
A kookaburra laughing, a short cheerful koo-koo-koo-ka-ka-ka laugh
An emu making soft deep drumming booms, thrum thrum thrum, gentle
A baby wombat making two soft huffy little grunts, hrmph hrmph, cute
A baby platypus making a soft cute grumbly churr, playful, not scary
A sugar glider making three tiny high yapping barks, yip yip yip, cute
A little lizard opening its frill with a soft papery flutter and a tiny cute hiss
A mole cricket singing from its burrow, a soft steady trilling churr
